truth_rechecks.answer: Unwrapping now describes adding/subtracting full turns and requires sampling that resolves crossings. No claim of reconstructing hidden turns from sparse endpoints remains.

paragraph_flow.reason: The opening states three concrete error causes and why they require controlled tests; it places the work as proposed before giving a protocol.
The setup fixes what is observed and the decoder before measuring retention. The defined decoder and different access levels connect earlier readout theory to the experiment.
A brief lead-in makes the following numbered sequence a procedure rather than an unexplained list.
The cue and its removal define writing and retention; testing between preferred positions prepares the later pinning diagnosis.
Fixed weights and recorded settings identify controlled conditions before outcomes are compared.
Delayed decoding specifies the observation; the unwrapping definition and sampling condition make angular handling actionable before the later full-turn limit.
Separate mean, variance and pattern failures expose different outcomes instead of averaging them into one accuracy score.
One-factor interventions and the same-model numerical reference turn a correlation between hardware and error into a controlled comparison.
The immediate baseline separates writing from later change; trial counts and coefficient uncertainty limit what fitted values establish.
The success criterion returns the procedure to cue discrimination. The cancellation warning explains why both earlier statistics are necessary.
The model lead-in restricts the forthcoming SDE to short intervals; the adjacent displayed equation was inspected directly.
Definitions connect local increments to measured drift and diffusion, then state correlations, boundaries and long-delay angular limits before the fit is used.
The new visible readout-noise instruction places the essential measurement condition on the first reading path. The constant-variance independence condition supports the constant offset.
The folded check supplies the two-reading calculation and failure conditions after the visible main conclusion; the reader can expand it for the exact intercept model.
Physical changes in leak, feedback and fluctuating currents motivate why the next mathematical projection is needed.
Local dynamics, noise mapping and normalization introduce the displayed projection coefficient; earlier Part I teaching was actually read, so the link is a route back to a supplied prerequisite.
The interpretation turns the covariance equation into corrected-versus-surviving directions and limits its drift claims. It supplies the main result before the folded derivation.
The folded derivation traces the projected stochastic increment into variance. It adds mathematical detail without hiding the only statement of the physical conclusion.
The table introduction retains model assumptions before interventions are listed. Every table row was read directly because the packet omits it.
The folded example title signals its specific question: why tighter spread need not mean better memory.
The example computes both MSEs and interprets pinning. Its main bias-versus-spread conclusion is already visible in Chapter 08 and in the protocol, so this calculation can remain folded.
The comparison lead-in marks a shift from device parameters to what each original paper can and cannot establish.
The 2012 bullet connects information and diffusion only under matched noise, dynamics and access. Directly exposing a stored internal angle changes that comparison.
The 2022 bullet puts filtering between internal command and observed motion, giving concrete hardware examples and the resulting calibration requirement.
The 2025 bullet distinguishes spatial response statistics from input-free temporal retention, preventing the common but unsupported inference between them.
The synthesis link and biological limit join the three bullets without promising that a chip reproduces an animal system.
The time-mapping paragraph derives the acceleration factor in physical diffusion units, then distinguishes ideal rescaling from actual communication and readout limits.
The energy paragraph uses the same task, delay and error requirements as the accuracy protocol and includes required host/interface work.

The closing research question names the changed physical component, the measured improvement and the fixed comparison conditions. It concludes with an experiment to perform, not a result already obtained.
